title: Finite simultaneous integral perfect charts
statement: Fix primes l and p with p different from l, a finite extension E/Q_l in the coefficient universe, and a separated finite-type scheme T over a field of characteristic p. Given a finite family K in the actual completed integral bounded constructible category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], there exist one ordered integer term interval [a,b] and one finite constructible stratification S of T with positive index set. Each member on each stratum admits a finite pro-etale cover carrying bounded finite-projective scalar complexes P over the actual valuation ring, strictly in [a,b], and integral completed-realization chart isomorphisms. On the same charts and for every positive exponent n+1, the actual derived reduction, transported through the canonical coefficient equivalence, is isomorphic to the constant realization of the termwise quotient complex P tensor_R R/I^(n+1). If all members are zero choose [0,0]. Empty lists and schemes are allowed. No finite-quotient homology, Tor bound, constructibility of reductions, or bounded etale-origin conclusion is asserted. Coefficients, reduction maps and slice restrictions use [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]. The actual derived slice restriction is [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-presheaves], and the finite scheme stratification is [def-constructible-stratification].

proof.text: Apply the local-perfect criterion over the actual valuation ring to each member of the finite family. The finite-type hypotheses make T Noetherian and finite-dimensional, and p differs from l so l is invertible. Each member has a finite locally closed stratification and perfect scalar models on covering sieves.

Intersect the finitely many stratifications by scheme fibre products. Transport the covering sieves and the same scalar models along the refinement projections, using normalized completed-coefficient inverse image and the derived tensor/pullback comparison. Noetherian locally closed subsets are constructible.

Quasi-compactness of every stratum selects finitely many covering pieces carrying their original scalar models. Take the minimum of their lower term bounds and zero, and the maximum of their upper term bounds and zero. These finite extrema give one ordered term interval, independent of the member and reduction index.

Compute every positive quotient on each unchanged chart by the perfect-chart tensor comparison. The normalized coefficient equivalence, exact stratum pullback and exact slice restriction identify this comparison with exactly the fixed-module derived chart isomorphism in the statement. No Tor or finite-homology conclusion enters this step.

For an all-zero family choose zero complexes, identity charts, identity stratification and [0,0]. The same choices handle the empty family. Empty schemes and covers are permitted; retain an empty identity stratum if necessary to make the stratum index positive.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.6.11, finite perfect chart argument and all-module tensor descent.

theorem pur_integral_finite_perfect_charts
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (_hpl : p ≠ l)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (T ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (T ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (s : ℕ) (K : Fin s → PbcCompletedDerived T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E))
    (_hK : ∀ j : Fin s,
      IsPbcBoundedConstructibleComplete T l E (K j)) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
      ((∀ j : Fin s, IsZero (K j)) → a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∧
      ∃ S : Stratification T, 0 < S.n ∧
        (∀ (r : Fin S.n) (j : Fin s),
          ∃ (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → (S.domain r).ProEt)
            (f : ∀ c : Fin m, U c ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 (S.domain r)))
            (P : Fin m → CochainComplex
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) ℤ),
            Presieve.ofArrows U f ∈ (ProEt.precoverage (S.domain r)).coverings _ ∧
            ∀ c : Fin m,
              ((P c).IsStrictlyGE a ∧ (P c).IsStrictlyLE b) ∧
              (∀ q : ℤ, Module.Projective (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
                ((P c).X q) ∧ Module.Finite (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
                  ((P c).X q)) ∧
              Nonempty (integralLocalDerived (S.immersion r)
                (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) (U c) (K j) ≅
                integralLocalDerived (S.immersion r)
                  (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) (U c)
                  ((integralConstantDerived T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)).obj
                    ((completedConstantQ _).obj (P c)))) ∧
              ∀ n : ℕ,
                Nonempty (purFixedChart (S.domain r)
                  (PbcQuotient (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E) n) (U c)
                  (purReductionOnStratum (S.immersion r)
                    (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E) (K j) n) ≅
                  purScalarComplexOnChart (S.domain r) (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)
                    (U c) (P c) n))
